parameters.query: SELECT e.id, e.status, e.registered_by, e.division_id, e.tournament_id, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.organizer_user_id, viewer.id AS viewer_id, tm.name AS team_name, d.name AS dname, d.max_teams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries x WHERE x.division_id = e.division_id AND x.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved, (SELECT m.role FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = e.team_id AND m.user_id = viewer.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE') AS my_team_role FROM tournament_entries e JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = e.tournament_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE e.id = $2
